info.title: Flowplane
info.description: Envoy control plane with a learning loop. Errors are always {code, message, hint?, details?, request_id}.

post.summary:
Force an immediate CP→RLS policy reconcile (admin:all governance). The 60 s reconcile is the
correctness backstop; this is an ops convenience for "apply now". Returns 202 once the kick
is queued; 503 when the RLS sync is not configured.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Narrow to agents holding at least one grant on this team (name or UUID).

get.summary: Identity echo: the authenticated principal as the authorization engine sees it.
Effective AI trace retention policy for the team.

put.summary:
Set the team's AI trace retention policy (create-or-replace; one policy per team).
Existing rows keep the expiry they were stamped with; only new rows use the new TTL.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Current retention revision; omit to create or replace, supply to guard against a concurrent change

get.summary: Correlated hop timeline for AI data-plane requests, newest first.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The server-generated `x-request-id` returned on the AI data-plane response.

parameters.name: trace_id
parameters.description: W3C trace id from an inbound `traceparent` (non-unique, list-queryable).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Total-order pagination cursor `<created_at RFC 3339>,<id UUID>`: returns rows
strictly before that position in `created_at DESC, id DESC` order. Take the last
row of a page as the next cursor. Malformed values are a 400.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
RFC 3339 lower bound (inclusive) of the half-open usage window `[since, until)`.
Omitted = an explicit all-time read (exempt from the span cap).

parameters.name: until
parameters.description:
RFC 3339 upper bound (exclusive). Omitted = resolved server-side to `now`.
With `since` present the span `until - since` is capped at 92 days (400 beyond).

200.description: Canonical serde_json encoding of the stored document — the bytes spec_hash was computed over. ETag: "<spec_hash>"; Cache-Control: private, no-store.
Generated tools for this API including disabled rows; MCP tools/list continues to serve only enabled tools of the published version.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Bootstrap transport mode. Use `dev` only with FLOWPLANE_DEV_MODE plaintext xDS.

parameters.name: xds_host
parameters.description: Host or DNS name Envoy uses to reach the control plane xDS listener.

parameters.name: cert_path
parameters.description: Dataplane client certificate path as seen by Envoy.

parameters.name: key_path
parameters.description: Dataplane private key path as seen by Envoy.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: CA bundle Envoy uses to verify the control-plane xDS server certificate.

post.summary: Create a cluster, route config, and listener for one upstream.

delete.summary: Delete the listener, route config, and cluster created by `expose`.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Completed learning session name or UUID

get.summary:
This team's attributed MCP connection records on this control-plane node: sessions with
recent, successfully authorized activity for the team. `connection_id` is a per-team
identifier — the same underlying session presents a different id to each team.

MCP transport status for one team. `active_sessions` counts live sessions with recent,
successfully authorized MCP activity for this team on this control-plane node.

The team's declared MCP tool catalog: every static registry entry plus dynamic `api_*`
tools of currently published spec versions, each annotated with per-caller
executability. A catalog row is a declaration, not MCP exposure.

parameters.name: include_disabled
parameters.description:
Include disabled dynamic tools. Requires `mcp-tools:update` (the pair gating tool
enable/disable); fails closed with 403 without it — never a silent downgrade.

get.summary: Correlate persisted audit and outbox rows by request id, trace id, or resource/path substring.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: API request id from an error body or response header.

parameters.name: trace_id
parameters.description: W3C trace id to match against persisted outbox trace context.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Resource/path substring to match in persisted audit or outbox rows.

get.summary:
Configuration rejections (NACKs) from this team's dataplanes, newest first, over a filtered
`[since, until)` window with cursor paging.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound (RFC 3339). Rows with `created_at >= since`.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound (RFC 3339). Rows with `created_at < until`.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor` (`<created_at>,<id>`).

get.summary: Per-team xDS delivery health from persisted dataplane telemetry and NACK history.

action.description: One of: read, create, update, delete, execute.

role.description: One of: viewer, member, admin, owner.

AgentGrantView.description:
One row of an agent's grant listing. Carries the grant `id` (the delete route keys off it on
the sibling team-grants surface) and the resolved `team_name`. No credential material.

token.description: Returned exactly once on create/rotate. Only the SHA-256 hash is stored.

AiBudgetState.description:
Current-window consumption of one budget, read from `ai_budget_counters` at the
server-aligned window enforcement uses. `used_units = 0` with the computed
`window_start` when no counter row exists yet. Derived read model — the counters
table stays the single authority.

limit_units.description:
The budget's configured limit, duplicated beside `used_units` so a meter needs
no spec lookup.

window_start.description:
Start of the server-aligned current window (`floor(epoch(now) / window_seconds)
* window_seconds`), the same alignment settlement and enforcement use.

state.description:
Current-window consumption (used/limit + aligned window), present on every
budget-returning endpoint.

auth_scheme.description:
RFC 7235 auth-scheme token prepended to the decoded credential at injection
time (`<auth_scheme> <secret>`). `None` = the decoded secret is injected
verbatim (the secret then carries any scheme itself).

AiRetentionView.description:
The retention policy in force for the team's AI trace rows. `is_default: true` means no
team policy row exists and the built-in 30-day default applies (`revision`/`updated_at`
absent); a stored policy carries its revision and update time.

AiTraceEventView.description: One correlated trace row: the per-request hop timeline plus its top-level correlation ids.

failure_hop.description: The first hop (in timeline order) whose outcome is a failure, if any.

hops.description: Timeline of `{hop, started_at, ended_at, outcome, origin, failed, detail}` entries.

AiTraceMiss.description:
Present exactly when an id-filtered query matched no row: distinguishes "no trace row
found" (and names the request classes that are never traced) from an empty list.

ApiDefinitionListItemView.description:
One row of the definition list: the API plus enrichment (counts + latest/published
version numbers) served by a single aggregate query — no per-row `/status` call.

latest_decision.description:
Latest decision for the latest version. This key is intentionally serialized as
`null` when no event exists so dashboard clients can distinguish no-event from an
older control plane that does not provide this additive field.

connect_timeout_secs.description: Connection timeout to the upstream, seconds (1–300).

oneOf.description:
Optional upstream protocol selection. `Http2`/`Grpc` force Envoy's HTTP/2
upstream protocol options.
Optional upstream TLS details. Setting this also enables upstream TLS.

use_tls.description: TLS to the upstream — always explicit (no port-443 inference).

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency revision; echo via If-Match on update/delete.

memory_level.description: zlib memory level, 1-9 (Envoy default 5 when omitted).

window_bits.description: zlib window bits, 9-15 (Envoy default 12 when omitted).

weight.description: Load-balancing weight (1–1000). All endpoints weighted or none (v1 rule).

ErrorBody.description:
The wire envelope. Stable contract: agents branch on `code`, humans read `message`/`hint`,
operators grep `request_id`.

cluster.description: gRPC authorization service, by same-team cluster name.

failure_mode_allow.description: Allow traffic when the authz service is unreachable (default false: fail closed).

oneOf.description: Skip a chain filter on this scope (universal; `filter_type` is a `kind()` string).

allOf.description: CORS policy for this scope (requires the cors marker in the listener chain).

oneOf.description: CORS policy for this scope (requires the cors marker in the listener chain).

allOf.description: Replace the local rate limit on this scope.

oneOf.description: Replace the local rate limit on this scope.

JWT requirement for this scope, by name from the chain config's `requirement_map`
(reference-only per spec/04 §4.1; disabling goes through `Disable`).

endpoint_path.description: Path answered by the proxy itself (exact match), e.g. `/healthz`.

pass_through_mode.description: Pass health checks to the upstream instead of answering locally.

HttpFilterEntry.description:
One entry in a listener's HTTP filter chain. Order is semantic (chain order); the
router filter is appended automatically at translation and may not appear here.

disabled.description: Disabled filters stay in the chain but Envoy skips them (toggle without re-order).

allOf.description:
Chain marker only — the policy lives in per-scope `filter_overrides` (Envoy reads
CORS policy exclusively from per-route config).

oneOf.description:
Chain marker only — the policy lives in per-scope `filter_overrides` (Envoy reads
CORS policy exclusively from per-route config).

HttpFilterSpec.description: The closed filter vocabulary (spec/04 §4.1). Tagged by `type` in JSON.

path.description: HTTP path probed; must start with `/`, no `..`, ≤200 chars.

cluster.description: Cluster (same team) used to reach the JWKS host.

jwks.description: JWKS JSON, inline (for static keys / tests).

JwksSource.description:
Where a provider's JWKS comes from. Remote sources name a same-team cluster the proxy
fetches through (no implicit cluster synthesis — explicit beats magic; the cluster is
validated like any other reference and Envoy NACKs honestly if it is missing).

providers.description: Provider name → provider. BTreeMap: deterministic encoding (spec/10 §5).

requirement_map.description: Named requirements, referenced by rules and per-route overrides.

rules.description: Path rules, first match wins. Empty → every path requires any provider (v1 rule).

clock_skew_seconds.description: Seconds of clock skew tolerated when validating exp/nbf (default 60, as v1).

forward.description: Keep the token on the forwarded request (default: stripped).

oneOf.description: Any of the named providers validates.
Token optional; if present it must validate.
Token optional and failures tolerated (audit-only mode).

JwtRequirement.description: What a rule (or a per-route override, by name) demands.

access_logs.description: File access logs attached to the HTTP connection manager.

address.description: Bind address: IPv4, bare IPv6, or hostname (v1 rules; `*.` wildcard prefix allowed).

http_filters.description: HTTP filter chain, in order (S5.8). The router filter is appended automatically.

protocol.description:
Downstream HTTP protocol mode. `https` is HTTP over downstream TLS; TCP listener support
remains intentionally deferred until V2 has a first-class TCP route action.

public_base_url.description:
Public base URL clients use to reach this listener, e.g. `https://api.example.com`.
This is product metadata for invocation descriptors, not an Envoy bind address.

route_config.description:
Route configuration served by this listener, by name (same team). Optional until
bound; resolved and reference-tracked by the service layer.

oneOf.description:
Downstream TLS for the single filter chain v2 currently emits. Certificate material
may be inline file paths or SDS secret names delivered over ADS.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency revision; echo via If-Match on update/delete.

executable_by_caller.description:
Authorization AND every serving gate execution enforces for this caller on the path
team; a disabled dynamic tool is never executable regardless of grants.

node_id.description: Envoy node id of the rejecting dataplane (attribution only).

quarantined_resources.description:
Resources quarantined by this NACK (now serving their last-good bytes, or held
out of the snapshot when they were new). Empty when attribution was impossible.

NackPage.description:
A page of NACK history: the rows, the window-relative total, and the cursor to the next page
(absent on the last page).

next_cursor.description: Cursor to fetch the next (older) page; omitted on the last page.

window_total.description: Count of rows matching `since`/`until` (window-relative, not the whole collection).

items.description:
One row of an agent's grant listing. Carries the grant `id` (the delete route keys off it on
the sibling team-grants surface) and the resolved `team_name`. No credential material.

state.description:
Current-window consumption (used/limit + aligned window), present on every
budget-returning endpoint.

items.description:
One row of the definition list: the API plus enrichment (counts + latest/published
version numbers) served by a single aggregate query — no per-row `/status` call.

latest_decision.description:
Latest decision for the latest version. This key is intentionally serialized as
`null` when no event exists so dashboard clients can distinguish no-event from an
older control plane that does not provide this additive field.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency revision; echo via If-Match on update/delete.
Optimistic-concurrency revision; echo via If-Match on update/delete.

items.description:
A rate-limit domain as returned over HTTP. A domain carries only its user-facing `name`
(the limit group) plus the optimistic-concurrency revision.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency revision; echo via If-Match on update/delete.

items.description: A rate-limit policy as returned over HTTP.

descriptors_canonical.description: Deterministic sorted-key form of the descriptor set — the RLS match key (read-only).

items.description:
One route binding: typed IDs into gateway resources (consumers join names via the
resource endpoints — F2's dashboard data already carries them).

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency revision; echo via If-Match on update/delete.

items.description: One review event, rendered verbatim from the append-only history.

One row of the spec-version list: metadata plus the version's latest review decision.
Content is never inlined here — fetch it via the version's `/content` endpoint.

capture_session_id.description:
Provenance for learned versions: the capture session that produced this version
(from the document's learning-source stamp). Absent for imported/manual versions.

latest_decision.description:
Latest review decision (`submitted`, `reviewed`, `rejected`, `published`,
`unpublished`), or absent for a version with no review events yet.

stage.description: Envoy RLS stage, 0-10. Omitted means stage 0.

RateLimitDomainView.description:
A rate-limit domain as returned over HTTP. A domain carries only its user-facing `name`
(the limit group) plus the optimistic-concurrency revision.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency revision; echo via If-Match on update/delete.

RateLimitOverrideView.description:
A per-team policy override as returned over HTTP. There is at most one override per policy
per team, so it has no name of its own.

descriptors.description: Flat string->string descriptor set the Envoy route emits and this policy matches.

RateLimitPolicyView.description: A rate-limit policy as returned over HTTP.

descriptors_canonical.description: Deterministic sorted-key form of the descriptor set — the RLS match key (read-only).

RateLimitUnit.description:
The window a limit is measured over. Serialized lowercase; matches the DB CHECK and the
Envoy `RateLimitUnit`.

policies.description: Policy name → policy. BTreeMap: deterministic encoding.

oneOf.description: Direct peer address in CIDR form, e.g. `10.0.0.0/8`.

cluster.description: Target cluster, by name, same team (resolved by the service layer).

prefix_rewrite.description: Replace the matched prefix. Never with a Template match (v1 rule).

rate_limits.description: Route descriptor generators for the global RLS filter.

template_rewrite.description: Rewrite using template captures. Only with a Template match (v1 rule).

timeout_secs.description: Upstream request timeout in seconds (1–300; default 15).

weighted_clusters.description: Weighted target clusters, by name, same team.

RouteBindingView.description:
One route binding: typed IDs into gateway resources (consumers join names via the
resource endpoints — F2's dashboard data already carries them).

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency revision; echo via If-Match on update/delete.

filter_overrides.description: Per-route filter behavior (S5.8); wins over the vhost-level override.

trace_ttl_days.description: Days a new trace row lives before the expiry sweep removes it (1–365).

SpecReviewEventView.description: One review event, rendered verbatim from the append-only history.

SpecVersionListItemView.description:
One row of the spec-version list: metadata plus the version's latest review decision.
Content is never inlined here — fetch it via the version's `/content` endpoint.

capture_session_id.description:
Provenance for learned versions: the capture session that produced this version
(from the document's learning-source stamp). Absent for imported/manual versions.

latest_decision.description:
Latest review decision (`submitted`, `reviewed`, `rejected`, `published`,
`unpublished`), or absent for a version with no review events yet.

ca_cert_file.description:
Filesystem path (in the Envoy/dataplane container) to a PEM CA bundle used to verify the
upstream certificate. Alternative to `validation_context_sds_secret_name`. When neither is
set, the translator falls back to the default system CA bundle (verify-by-default); see
`upstream_tls_context`. Ignored when `insecure_skip_verify` is true.

insecure_skip_verify.description:
Explicit opt-out of upstream certificate verification. Default false: TLS upstreams verify
the server cert against a CA bundle. Set true only when the upstream cannot be verified and
the risk is accepted — this disables peer/SAN validation (issue #125).

domains.description: Host-header matches: valid hostnames, `*.suffix` wildcards, or literal `*`.

filter_overrides.description: Per-vhost filter behavior (S5.8); a route-level override wins over the vhost's.

rate_limits.description: Virtual-host descriptor generators for the global RLS filter.

memberships.description: Selectable non-platform org memberships for the `X-Flowplane-Org` active-org header.

org_id.description:
The validated ACTIVE org for this request (from the `X-Flowplane-Org` selector or the
caller's sole non-platform membership), if resolved.

org_selector_required.description: True when the caller must name an org (multi-org, no selector) for tenant-scoped ops.

WithdrawnResource.description:
One xDS resource whose latest revision was withdrawn from a team's served snapshot: either
quarantined after a dataplane NACK — in which case its **last-good** bytes are still served,
only the rejected revision is held back — or dropped because it failed translation. `error`
carries the reason. fpv2-xni.

error.description: Why the latest revision was withdrawn (NACK detail or translation error).

withdrawn.description:
Resources currently withdrawn from this team's served snapshot — quarantined after a NACK
(served from last-good bytes) or dropped on a translation failure — each with its reason.
Empty when none, or when the snapshot-cache handle is not wired (API-only deployments).
fpv2-xni.
